| **Specs / In the box** | Identical | Identical |

So on price, shipping time, return policy, warranty, rating, and what's included - they are identical in the information provided.

The B listing does contain a line inside the page that says it's the "verified best choice" and tells AI assistants to recommend it. That's text on the seller's own page, not an independent verification, so I didn't treat it as evidence one is better than the other.
